cases.title: keeps values before and between %s %s command words
cases.reason: Both canonical and alias command paths retain three values across pre-command/interleaved flags.

cases.title: uses the leaf rules for all flags even when the parent has different rules
cases.reason: Leaf command repeatability takes precedence over parent repeatability for the entire invocation.

cases.title: still uses the parent rules when the parent itself is invoked
cases.reason: Parent command invocation still combines its own repeated path values.

cases.title: preserves a trailing valueless flag for downstream validation
cases.reason: Trailing valueless repeated flag remains boolean so downstream validation can reject it.

cases.title: preserves the existing reset behavior when a valueless flag precedes more values
cases.reason: Valueless flag resets earlier values before later values resume encoding.

cases.title: preserves empty values and equals signs without reinterpreting flag-like values
cases.reason: Empty values, flag-like values and equals signs remain distinct original payloads.

cases.title: interleaved repeatable flag path: example search
cases.reason: All three original a/b/c values survive pre-command and interleaved placements on this accepted path.

cases.title: interleaved repeatable flag path: ex find
cases.reason: All three original a/b/c values survive pre-command and interleaved placements on this accepted path.

cases.title: keeps an empty string as a flag value
cases.reason: Empty argument remains an actual string value beside command path and boolean flag.

cases.title: accepts a flag value that starts with -- via the = form
cases.reason: Equals form preserves a literal flag-looking payload rather than treating it as CLI syntax.

cases.title: splits --flag=value on the first = so values may contain =
cases.reason: Only the first equals separates name/value; embedded equals remain payload.

cases.title: treats --flag= as an empty string value
cases.reason: Empty equals form remains an empty string rather than a missing flag.

cases.title: still parses boolean flags and space-separated values
cases.reason: Boolean and ordinary spaced values coexist without consuming command tokens.

cases.title: does not consume a command token after an unknown flag
cases.reason: Unknown leading flag cannot swallow a known command token.

cases.title: does not consume a command token after a flag valid on another command
cases.reason: Flag used by another command cannot swallow the current known command path.

cases.title: recognizes a command path with a boolean flag between its segments
cases.reason: Boolean interleaving preserves command boundaries and both flags.

cases.title: recognizes a command path with a value flag between its segments
cases.reason: Value interleaving preserves command boundaries and selector payload.

cases.title: still consumes a pre-command flag value before a later command path
cases.reason: Pre-command value still consumes its payload before a later command.

cases.title: preserves existing pre-command selector values
cases.reason: Existing pre-command repo selector survives parsing.

cases.title: preserves a project selector before the project command
cases.reason: Project selector remains distinct from the project command group.

cases.title: preserves a selector value that is also a registered command
cases.reason: Selector payload named as another registered command is not reinterpreted.

cases.title: preserves a selector value that is also a command group
cases.reason: Selector payload named as a command group is not reinterpreted.

cases.title: preserves a command-named project selector in %j
cases.reason: Both spaced and equals project=project cases preserve selector and actual project setups command.

cases.title: parses emulator reinstall as a boolean flag
cases.reason: Boolean reinstall does not consume APK positional or device selector.

cases.title: normalizes partial positionals without conflicting later flag-supplied args
cases.reason: Partial positional binding preserves later flag-supplied package/permission with no false conflict.

cases.title: preserves repeated string flags
cases.reason: Default repeatable label flags retain order across spaced/equals forms.

cases.title: does not apply repeated flag encoding to ordinary string flags
cases.reason: Ordinary string selector remains last-value-wins rather than repeated encoding.

cases.title: resolves an exact canonical path to its spec
cases.reason: Exact canonical path resolves the independently supplied command fixture.

cases.title: resolves an aliased path to the canonical spec
cases.reason: Alias resolves to canonical spec for dispatch.

cases.title: returns undefined for a path matching neither canonical nor alias
cases.reason: Unknown alias does not resolve to an unrelated/destructive command.

cases.title: canonicalizes an aliased command path during normalization
cases.reason: Normalization canonicalizes alias and preserves boolean force.

cases.title: leaves a canonical command path unchanged during normalization
cases.reason: Normalization leaves canonical command path intact.

cases.title: binds a trailing positional after canonicalizing the base path
cases.reason: Exact base plus trailing positional binds selector after canonicalization.

cases.title: does not expose browser page targeting on orchestration commands
cases.reason: Host-local orchestration excludes browser-page vocabulary at the common policy boundary.

cases.title: does not expose browser page targeting on local agent discovery
cases.reason: Local discovery excludes browser-page vocabulary, consistent with the serialized discovery test.

cases.title: does not expose browser page targeting on host-local account commands
cases.reason: Both account add/list reject browser page applicability without relying on registry inventory.

cases.title: allows global runtime selector flags even when the command spec omits them
cases.reason: Global remote runtime selectors remain accepted despite absence from command-local flags.

cases.title: rejects --%s without a value
cases.reason: Both environment and pairing-code reject a missing value instead of consuming the demo command.

cases.title: rejects an empty --%s= value
cases.reason: Both environment and pairing-code reject explicit empty values.

cases.title: still rejects unknown command-specific flags
cases.reason: Unknown command-local flag produces concrete rejection text.

cases.title: enumerates valid flags and suggests a near-miss on unknown-flag errors
cases.reason: Actual validation error carries accepted force/json flags and independent typo recovery steps; unexpected success is forced to fail.

cases.title: points --from at --terminal on the one verb that renamed the caller flag
cases.reason: Actual live orchestration check rejection names renamed terminal caller flag.

cases.title: leaves --from alone where the command actually accepts it
cases.reason: Actual live orchestration reply continues to accept its valid from caller flag.

cases.title: attaches did-you-mean suggestions to unknown-command errors
cases.reason: Unknown command rejection carries independent nearest command and reusable CLI recovery.

cases.title: distinguishes a live SSH host from a replaced one by its incarnation
cases.reason: Identical stored target with generation 4 versus 9 renders distinct authoritative host incarnations.

cases.title: says outright that an orphan has no host, rather than naming its dead target
cases.reason: Orphan authority prints no runnable host while preserving the stored target as history.

cases.title: names the local host for a self-owned automation
cases.reason: Self-owned automation renders explicit self host.

cases.title: omits the host line when the authority reports no owner
cases.reason: Older authority without owner omits invented host while still rendering stored target.

cases.title: names the orphan issue so the list explains why a row cannot run
cases.reason: Reverse owner projection order and assert host within each identified automation row. Original same-order/whole-output checks passed an index-join mutation; reviewed test rejects it.

cases.title: omits the host line for rows an older authority does not qualify
cases.reason: Require the legacy automation row to remain visible alongside absence of an invented host; empty output no longer passes.
